artworks.title: Diana and Callisto
artworks.description: Titian's poesie: Diana points in judgement as Callisto's companions strip her garment — the pregnancy that betrays the vow and starts the road to the bears.

artworks.title: Diana and Callisto
artworks.description: Rubens' Prado wood: bathing nymphs turn on the disgraced Callisto — Ovid's exposure scene before Hera's wrath and the twin constellations.

artworks.title: Jupiter in the Guise of Diana, and the Nymph Callisto
artworks.description: Boucher's Rococo deception: Zeus as Diana embraces Callisto — the assault that will make Arcas, then the Great and Little Bears.

artworks.title: Apulian Red-Figure Chous with Kallisto Turning into a Bear
artworks.artist: Attributed near the Black Fury Group
artworks.description: South Italian chous (Getty): Callisto mid-metamorphosis into a bear — the Arcadian turn that places mother and son among the stars.

popCulture.title: Ursa Major
popCulture.description: Callisto and Arcas among the stars remain the episode's lasting sky-map — mother and son as the twin bears.
